_comment: The hand-owned half of the board. Everything here is a judgement a human makes; everything NOT here is derived by render-board.mjs from source files or scripts. Keep it small: if a value can be computed, compute it instead of typing it. Measured facts (served sha, since, migration counts, the stamp) are REFUSED here: they live in measured-facts.json, written by collect-board-facts.mjs; prose cites them as {{prod.sha}}-style tokens.
stage: Stage 3 — one source table, then prevention
headline: Stage 3's slices are merged and staging is the release gate. Production has not moved since {{prod.since_date}} ({{prod.migrations_behind}} migrations behind) and is not scheduled to. Staging serves {{staging.sha}}; the 13:30 IST window brings the merge log and NOT_EXTRACTABLE admission.

waiting_on_owner.ask: May a config-only production deploy (no build) run in any evening window, rather than only the weekly release?
waiting_on_owner.why: The weekly rule exists to limit BUILDS on the 2-vCPU box that serves production. A config deploy copies one JSON file and restarts nothing, so the cost it guards against is absent.
waiting_on_owner.blocks: Nothing today. Decide before the first prod config change.

waiting_on_owner.ask: How old may a field's last-confirmed date get before the page marks it stale?
waiting_on_owner.recommend: 7 days for document-sourced fields, 1 day for live figures
waiting_on_owner.why: Item 21 is stuck at PARTIAL only because this number has no value. It is an owner decision, not a build.

waiting_on_owner.ask: Production is {{prod.migrations_behind}} migrations behind main. Rehearse the batch against a prod-shaped copy before the release?
waiting_on_owner.why: These have never been run as ONE batch against prod's exact schema. Individually each is cheap at current row counts; as a batch, untested.

waiting_on_owner.ask: When a merge is undone, may the IPO's scraper-derived child rows (documents, subscriptions, GMP) be rebuilt by the next scrape rather than restored from the log?
waiting_on_owner.recommend: Yes, rebuild; but restore person-created rows and provenance exactly
waiting_on_owner.why: The spec says restore both rows whole. Copying every derived row across ~40 tables inside each merge is heavy; watchlists, reviews and field provenance are small and cannot be re-scraped. An independent review found the current merge already DELETES every watcher of the dropped row when one user watched both, which is fixed first either way.
waiting_on_owner.blocks: Item 19 step 3 (unmerge). The merge-correctness fix proceeds meanwhile.

environments.note: Behind main — ipo_field_plan, field_extraction_failures, field_source_overrides, document_pages, ipo_merge_log do not exist here.
0051 (merge log) arrives in the 13:30 IST window. Field-plan generator and walk flags ON (staging/scraper.env). This is the release gate — the bar is feature-complete here, not a green build.
environments.flags: manifest ON, field plan + walk ON

environments.note: The one sanctioned local Postgres, reached on localhost:15432 through the tunnel. Integration and real-writer tests run here.

release.window: One production window per day, ~21:00–23:30 IST, owner-worded only.
release.branch: Prod deploys only from a frozen release/prod-<date> branch, never from main.
release.contents: Not cut. The next release must carry the 16 pending migrations first, then the stage 3 slices.
release.rollback: gh workflow run deploy-linux.yml --ref release/prod-<previous> -f slot=prod; config-only changes roll back with deploy-config.sh and the previous sha.

gates.name: PR gate (lint, types, unit)
gates.detail: Green on main. The only workflow that runs on a PR.

gates.name: Integration / E2E
gates.detail: workflow_dispatch only — does NOT run on a PR. A green PR gate is not a green CI.

gates.name: Swap Test (stage acceptance)
gates.detail: Path 2 run on staging 2026-09-22: override set, no re-rank seen, cause unknown (#893 — its 'flags missing' premise was wrong, both flags are ON). Stage 3 is not done until it passes.

gates.name: Detection floor
gates.detail: 2026-09-23: 4 NEW entities, all resolved (#896). Two checks were themselves wrong: NSE status check false-flagged every SME IPO (#895, fixed #898); verdict-leak check red 4 nights on the public IPO rating (#897, open).

gates.name: Build-card gate
gates.detail: Accepts Status: unknown as valid, which is why 24 of 42 cards say nothing (#810).

reader_impact.what: Some live IPOs show a smaller issue size than the real one
reader_impact.plain: Example today on ipodhan.com: Himalayan Solar shows ₹64.73 cr; the real figure is ₹68.03 cr (priced at the lower band instead of the upper). Staging already shows ₹68.03 cr.
reader_impact.status: Fixed on main for new writes (BSE no longer writes issue size); readers see it only after a production release.

reader_impact.plain: Where two sources disagree the reader is shown one value with no sign anything is in doubt. The oldest has been open 96 days.
reader_impact.status: Figure measured 2026-09-20, not re-measured since. The prevention model stops new ones; draining the old pile is the admin queue (S9, queued).

reader_impact.what: Every fix of the last {{prod.age_days}} days is invisible to readers
reader_impact.plain: Fix and feature commits on main are not on the live site (217 counted on 2026-09-23), because production has not deployed since {{prod.since_date}}.
reader_impact.status: By design — the owner's bar is feature-complete staging before a prod window.

chain.what: 19 (unmerge), S6 churn-stop, Swap Test, #884 stranded plan rows

lines: The merge log landed (#888): every merge now records the dropped row, so a wrong merge can later be undone. The undo tool itself is not built yet.
Documents nothing can read are stamped NOT_EXTRACTABLE when found (#891), so PENDING again means 'waiting to be read'. The old rows are repaired on staging next.
Two detection checks were fixing themselves into noise: the NSE status check (#898, fixed) and the verdict-leak check (#897, open).
#884 is about 43 times bigger than first filed: about 6,220 staging plan rows stuck at the retry cap because a source has no code for that field, not 144.
This board's hand-typed facts had not been updated since 2026-09-20 although the page was republished seven times; that failure is being fixed so facts are measured, not typed.

now.Landed: Since 2026-09-20: #859/#863 checks, #867 NSE fetcher, #870, #871, #876, #883, #888 merge log, #891 NOT_EXTRACTABLE, #898. Staging serves {{staging.sha}}.
now.Next: Run the NOT_EXTRACTABLE repair on staging, then the closed-IPO job on staging (#717), then item 19 unmerge and #884.
